title: The surviving cohomology of the native smooth exceptional constant object
statement: Let k₀ be a finite field and ℓ a prime different from its characteristic. Let a₀ : X₀ → Spec k₀ be separated, finite type, and smooth of relative dimension d ∈ ℕ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. In the native derived category [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], let J be any right adjoint of Ra₀! with adjunction adj. There is an isomorphism of constructible Weil sheaves H^(−2d)(J(ℚ̄_ℓ,Spec k₀[0])) ≅ ℚ̄_ℓ,X₀(d) ⊗ ℚ̄_ℓ,X₀. The constants have the canonical Weil structure [def-weil-constant-weil-structure] and the Tate line has the canonical Frobenius twist [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists]. The tensor is the native lisse tensor convention. This assertion says nothing about the other cohomology degrees.

proof.text: Base change a₀ to the algebraic closure. Separated finite type and smooth relative dimension d persist. Apply the counit-normalized native exceptional forgetting comparison to adj at the constant point object. Its scalar-unit normalization identifies the result with the ordinary common-stage exceptional constant object, including closure transport.

proof.text: Apply the smooth dualizing specialization of the coefficient-stage purity theorem. Its finite normalized trace is transported by integral reconstruction, rationalization, and common-stage descent exactly as in unit sk-thm-purity-transport. The resulting ordinary object is the constant Tate line shifted by 2d.

source.place: Apply smooth purity to the structure morphism and the constant coefficient object; native exceptional adjunction and canonical Frobenius refinement.

proof.text: Take degree −2d cohomology of the counit-normalized purity map. Apply the constant-purity Frobenius square to the same geometric structure morphism: its source is the canonical shifted Tate line, and its target action is the exceptional adjunction mate. To identify the native action under the exceptional comparison, transport the native counit equivariance through the normalized compact-support comparison. Transpose this equation through the ordinary adjunction: it uniquely specifies the action v by ε F(v) a = θ Q(ε). The native scalar Frobenius counit lemma computes the solution as v = G(θ)b, with b the inverse-exchange mate. Thus the native action is precisely the target action of the constant-purity square. Taking cohomology gives the claimed intertwiner with the canonical Tate action. Its inverse intertwines by multiplication with the two inverses. Exact forgetting computes cohomology, hence this gives an isomorphism of pro-etale Weil sheaves, which lifts to the full constructible subcategory. The native tensor convention presents the target as the Tate line tensor the constant sheaf. This uses no vanishing in other degrees.
